response.sql: SELECT AVG(UnitPrice) AS avg_unit_price, AVG(CAST(Bytes AS REAL) / Milliseconds) AS avg_bytes_per_ms FROM Track WHERE Bytes >= 10323804;

assumptions.assumption: The average bytes per millisecond is the mean of the per-track ratio Bytes/Milliseconds (not total Bytes divided by total Milliseconds); the cast to REAL avoids integer division.
Tracks with NULL Bytes are excluded automatically by the >= filter; Milliseconds is NOT NULL and assumed nonzero.

alternatives.interpretation: Ratio of aggregates: total Bytes divided by total Milliseconds across qualifying tracks, rather than the mean of per-track ratios.
alternatives.sql: SELECT AVG(UnitPrice) AS avg_unit_price, CAST(SUM(Bytes) AS REAL) / SUM(Milliseconds) AS avg_bytes_per_ms FROM Track WHERE Bytes >= 10323804;
